_comment: One question per call (JUDGE_SINGLE=1). Tier 2 unlocks on two_wheels alone. Gating it on is_bicycle as well withheld the frame's value from 82 of the 98 rollouts that actually drew one — 84% of the model's structural progress was invisible to the reward — because is_bicycle is the fuzziest item and was acting as a veto. Two circles are still capped at 0.30: that cap comes from having no frame, not from the gate.
_suffix: Reply with only the word true or the word false.

_retired.equal_wheels: always true — passed the wheels-unequal rung too
_retired.steering: always false — the judge cannot see a fork even on the gold bicycle
_retired.drivetrain: always false — cannot see a chain either

is_bicycle: Would someone glancing at this drawing say it is a bicycle? Answer false if it is only circles, blobs or abstract shapes.
two_wheels: Does this drawing show exactly two wheel-like round shapes, both fully drawn?
wheels_apart: Are the two wheels clearly separated with a gap between them, neither touching nor overlapping?
frame_spans: Do straight drawn lines join the two wheels to each other, meeting them at or near their centres?
closed_frame: Do the straight lines between the wheels form a closed shape with no gaps?
